content: The counting task is non-trivial. Counting has long been considered to be a challenging task in multimodal reasoning BIBREF28, BIBREF29. To explore how well the LRCN1u model copes with counting tasks, we generated two Quantification datasets. The Quant-Count captions describe the number of objects with certain attributes that appear in an image (e.g. “Exactly four shapes are crosses”), while the Quant-Ratio captions describe the ratio of certain objects (e.g. “A third of the shapes are blue squares”).
